==================================================
ARCHITECTURAL PRINCIPLES
==================================================

Follow these principles:

1. Keep the architecture simple.

2. Prefer established patterns over experimental technologies.

3. Avoid premature abstraction.

4. Use reusable components where repetition genuinely exists.

5. Do not create a component simply for every small HTML element.

6. Keep business logic separate from presentation where appropriate.

7. Prefer server-side rendering and React Server Components by default.

8. Only use Client Components when browser interactivity genuinely requires them.

9. Optimise images correctly using Next.js capabilities.

10. Avoid unnecessary JavaScript being sent to the browser.

11. Build accessibility into the architecture rather than adding it at the end.

12. Build SEO into page and content architecture from the beginning.

13. Ensure the architecture can support future pages and services without major restructuring.

14. Make the architecture understandable by a human developer and other AI agents.
